title: Lesson 13: RAG Quality: Reranking, Hybrid Search, Metadata Filtering, and Freshness
description: The four levers that turn a RAG demo into a system you can trust: reranking to fix top-k precision, hybrid search so exact terms still win, metadata filtering so access control and scope survive retrieval, and freshness so the answers do not go stale.

Lesson 12 promised the next two steps that fix what pure vector search misses: hybrid search, which pairs vector similarity with keyword matching, and reranking, which scores the retrieved chunks a second time before the model sees them.
